sources.title: Moon Jae-in: birth, education, presidential staff, assembly and presidential terms
sources.findings: Read Presidential Archives biography: January 24, 1953 Geoje birth; 1980 Kyung Hee law graduation and judicial exam; 2003–2004/2005–2006 civil-affairs secretary, 2004–2005 civic-society secretary, 2007–2008 chief of staff and 2007 summit preparation; 2012–2016 assembly, 2015 party leadership across renaming, 2017–2022 presidency. Historical post list is not current office. Korean 19th presidency numbering differs from number of distinct people; portrait caption 12th individual is not adopted as term numbering.

sources.title: 2017 official profile: 1980 LL.B., 1982 legal career and May 10 inaugural address
sources.findings: Read relevant official 2017 profile and inaugural-address sections: LL.B. Kyung Hee 1980, 1982 legal collaboration with Roh, May 10, 2017 inauguration. Academic degree, judicial exam and professional training are separate. No doctoral degree, independent diploma authentication or claim to have reviewed every campaign promise. Promotional promises are not measured accomplishments.

sources.title: Historical chronology through May 2017; selected dates cross-checked against archives
sources.findings: Read Yonhap historical chronology: 1975 democracy-protest imprisonment, 1980 law graduation/exam, 1982–1995 human-rights/labour practice in Busan, Roh staff service, 2012 Sasang parliamentary election and presidential defeat, May 9, 2017 election. Its 2015 sentence about Ahn Cheol-soo departure and party election has problematic sequencing; not used for intra-party chronology. Archives independently support leadership and renamed-party continuity. Published in 2017, not a 2026 current-office source.

sources.title: Text of the Panmunjom Declaration, 27 April 2018
sources.findings: Read UN Peacemaker-hosted Panmunjom Declaration: April 27, 2018 Peace House summit, shared goals for relations, military tensions, peace regime and complete denuclearization. These are commitments and intended negotiations, not an already signed final peace treaty, completed disarmament or permanent end of tensions. Hosting-path date 2024 is not agreement date.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Republic of Korea
sources.title: Pyongyang Joint Declaration dated 19 September 2018; official-hosted English translation
sources.findings: Read MOFA-hosted English declaration title, preface and opening clauses: September 18–20 Pyongyang summit, September 19 declaration, military implementation agreement as annex, tension reduction and exchanges. Page posted September 21 and explicitly labels English an unofficial translation sourced to Cheong Wa Dae. Follow-up open returned 403; do not claim all clauses, signatures, annex details or later implementation records inspected. Content uses only read portions.

sources.title: Parliament approves phased 52-hour maximum workweek, 28 February 2018
sources.findings: Read contemporaneous Yonhap February 28, 2018 legislative report: 68-hour previous maximum versus 52-hour revised maximum including 40 regular plus 12 overtime; parliamentary passage and phased application by company size from July 2018, January 2020 and July 2021, with exemptions. Describe generally applicable cap, not standard 52-hour requirement for every worker or all sectors. No current 2026 labour-law compliance audit or measured universal reduction claimed.

sources.title: Farewell speech on final day in office, 9 May 2022
sources.findings: Read May 9, 2022 Yonhap farewell report identifying final day of five-year term and successor Yoon due to take office May 10. Official archives independently confirm May 2022 end. Moon statements about pandemic/economic/climate achievements are his retrospective claims, not independently audited results and not adopted as such. Report also documents stalled dialogue after Hanoi; no claim 2018 declarations achieved permanent peace.

sources.title: Pyeongsan Bookstore anniversary: opening date, foundation governance and volunteer role, 9 August 2026
sources.findings: Read Korean Hankook Ilbo August 9, 2026 report quoting bookstore: opened April 25, 2023; foundation established it, Ahn Do-hyun chairs foundation, committee includes residents, Moon volunteers as bookseller. Do not turn volunteer role into sole ownership/chairmanship. Visitor and donation counts are attributed organizational claims, unused as independently audited outcomes. June 18, 2025 accompanying photo is not fresh August 2026 personal appearance.

sources.title: Bribery indictment and legal-team response, 24 April 2025
sources.findings: Read Yonhap April 24, 2025 third-update indictment report with lawyers’ response: prosecutors allege about 217 million won in compensation/benefits for former son-in-law through Thai Eastar Jet constituted benefits to Moon; lawyers denounce prosecution as political and fabricated. Neither allegations nor defense statements are adjudicated facts. Daughter/ex-son-in-law and co-defendant Lee Sang-jik are distinct people; other defendants’ convictions cannot be attributed to Moon.

sources.title: Moon criticizes indictment in personal remarks, 25 April 2025
sources.findings: Read Yonhap April 25, 2025 personal response at meeting with speaker Woo Won-sik: Moon criticizes indictment as unjust and misuse of prosecutorial power. His response is separate from day-earlier indictment and lawyers’ statement. His demand to restore military agreement is advocacy, not proof agreement had already been restored or that courts accepted his defense.

sources.title: Ninth preparatory hearing: January 2027 trial and conditional verdict schedule, 17 November 2026
sources.findings: Read Korean Newsis November 17, 2026 ninth preparatory hearing report: planned citizen-participation trial January 11–22, 2027, possible verdict afternoon January 22 conditional on progress, another preparatory hearing planned December 15. November 17 is hearing/report date, not Moon conviction or necessarily personal court appearance; photo is September 18 archival speech. Earlier October 20 expectations to end preparation in November are superseded. No claim final schedule fixed, guilty verdict issued or appeal rights exhausted.

sources.title: Korean original: completed address at declaration anniversary, 18 September 2026
sources.findings: Read SBS Korean original September 18, 2026 speech and compared English AI translation: actual National Assembly anniversary address calls for North–South and North Korea–US dialogue and restoration of military de-escalation arrangements. Claims about other leaders’ intentions remain Moon’s assertions; no successful new summit, deployed troops, restored hotline or enacted policy inferred from his speech.

sources.title: Korean original: completed Gunsan visits separated from later itinerary, 10 November 2026
sources.findings: Read SBS Korean original November 10, 2026 visit and compared AI English: arrival/lunch with former aides, shipyard briefing and island trail walk already occurred. Later Saemangeum 33 Center, medical-device company and dinner were still planned at publication; no completion claimed. Moon accompanied Kim Jung-sook, not current president/first lady. Shipyard acquisition process not final acquisition; infrastructure and pandemic claims not independently adopted.
